record.dic_text:
01271 Barzillay {bar-zil-lai'}

源自 01270; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Barzillai 12; 12

巴西萊 = "鐵人"
1) 一個吉甲人領袖, 幫助大衛王攻打謀反的押沙龍
2)一個祭司, 吉甲人巴西萊的女婿 (#拉 2:61; 尼 7:63|)
3) 一個來自瑪哈拉的以色列人, 他的兒子亞得列與掃羅的長女米拉結婚 (#撒下 21:8|)
record.edic_text:
01271 Barzillay {bar-zil-lah'-ee}

from 01270;; n pr m

AV - Barzillai 12; 12

Barzillai = "my iron"
1) a Gileadite leader who helped David defeat Absalom's rebellion
2) a priest, son-in-law to Barzillai the Gileadite
3) an Israelite from Mahalath whose son Adriel married Michal, Saul's
   daughter
